name: Hanami mobile demo
postCreateCommand: npm install && npm run build && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); fs.mkdirSync("data",{recursive:true}); if(!fs.existsSync("data/config.json")) fs.writeFileSync("data/config.json",JSON.stringify({backendUrl:"http://127.0.0.1:5199/v1",model:"mock-sakura"},null,2));'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5199/v1/models >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup npm run mock-llm >/tmp/hanami-mock.log 2>&1 </dev/null & fi; if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7788/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup npm start >/tmp/hanami-app.log 2>&1 </dev/null & fi; true'
